title: [Shopify] Don't block Shops page when user lacks extension permissions
summary: The Shopify Shops page no longer fails to open on Belgian environments when users lack extension installation permissions. A permission error during the installation status check now skips the notification instead of blocking the page.
key_points: Wrapped installation status check in a try function to gracefully handle permission errors
Users without extension install permissions can now open the Shopify Shops page
The notification is skipped when its underlying check fails, avoiding blocker errors
Change is specific to Belgian localization and the extension notification feature
quote: wraps the install-status check in a [TryFunction] so a permission (or any) error simply skips the notification instead of blocking the page
